cart.reason: Phosphor's 'shopping-cart' is a cart with wheels, the standard e-commerce cart icon. Also has 'shopping-cart-simple' but the detailed version is more recognizable.

add-to-cart.reason: Phosphor has no 'shopping-cart-plus' icon. 'shopping-cart-simple' is a simplified cart that pairs with 'shopping-cart' for the add-to-cart action. No perfect match exists; this is the closest distinct cart variant.

remove-from-cart.reason: Phosphor has no cart-minus or cart-remove icon. Using a generic cart variant would be ambiguous and indistinguishable from 'cart' or 'add-to-cart'.

payment.reason: Phosphor's 'credit-card' is the standard payment card icon for billing and checkout flows

wallet.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a folding wallet icon for digital wallet or payment concepts

money.reason: Phosphor's 'currency-dollar' shows a dollar sign, the standard money/currency icon. Also has 'currency-circle-dollar' but the bare symbol is more versatile.

tag.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a price tag icon for labels and pricing

tags.reason: Phosphor has no plural 'tags' icon showing multiple tags. Falls back to the single 'tag' icon as the closest match.

discount.reason: Phosphor's 'percent' is a percentage symbol icon, the standard discount/sale indicator

coupon.reason: Phosphor's 'ticket' is a ticket/voucher icon, the closest match for coupon or promotional codes

package.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a shipping box icon for packages and orders

shipping.reason: Phosphor's 'truck' is a delivery truck icon, the standard shipping/logistics symbol

delivery.reason: Same as shipping -- Phosphor's 'truck' icon is the universal delivery symbol. No distinct 'express delivery' icon exists in Phosphor.

return.reason: Phosphor's 'arrow-u-up-left' is a U-turn arrow pointing back, conveying the return/refund concept. Candidates: 'arrows-counter-clockwise' (more like sync), 'arrow-bend-up-left' (less clear). U-turn arrow is the most intuitive return metaphor.

receipt.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a receipt/bill icon for transaction records

invoice.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, an invoice document icon for billing

store.reason: Phosphor's 'storefront' is a shop facade with an awning, the standard store/shop icon. Confirmed on Iconify and v0.app.

shopping-bag.reason: Phosphor's 'bag' is a shopping bag icon. Also has 'handbag' and 'tote' but 'bag' is the most generic shopping bag match.

calendar.reason: Phosphor's 'calendar-blank' is a clean calendar icon without date numbers, suitable as a generic calendar symbol. 'calendar' in Phosphor has a specific date shown.

schedule.reason: Phosphor's 'calendar-dots' shows a calendar with event dots, conveying a schedule with multiple events. Candidates: 'calendar' (shows a single date), 'calendar-blank' (too plain). Dots suggest multiple scheduled items.

scheduled.reason: Phosphor's 'calendar-check' shows a calendar with a checkmark, conveying a confirmed scheduled date or completed due date

overdue.reason: Phosphor's 'calendar-x' shows a calendar with an X, conveying a missed or cancelled date, suitable for overdue/deadline-passed states

time.reason: Phosphor's 'clock' is the standard clock/time icon. Confirmed on v0.app.

timer.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a stopwatch/countdown timer icon. Confirmed on v0.app.

watch.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a wristwatch icon for smartwatch or time-on-wrist concept

layers.reason: Phosphor's 'stack' shows stacked layers, representing layered content. Candidates: 'squares-four' (grid, not layers). 'stack' is the direct layer/stack metaphor.

subtask.reason: Phosphor has no dedicated subtask/child-task icon. 'git-merge' shows a branching structure that visually conveys a parent-child relationship. Candidates: 'tree-structure' (too hierarchical), 'flow-arrow' (too abstract). 'git-merge' is the best available branching metaphor for subtasks.

tree.reason: Phosphor's 'tree-structure' shows a hierarchical tree diagram, directly matching org-chart/sitemap concepts. Confirmed on v0.app.

progress.reason: Phosphor's 'hourglass' conveys in-progress/pending state. Candidates: 'spinner' (loading, not progress), 'circle-notch' (too generic). Hourglass is a widely recognized progress metaphor. Phosphor also has 'hourglass-low' and 'hourglass-simple' variants.

milestone.reason: Phosphor's 'flag-pennant' is a triangular flag/pennant, commonly used to mark milestones and checkpoints in project management. Candidates: 'diamond' (too geometric), 'flag' (too generic). Pennant specifically evokes achievement milestones.

tasks.reason: Phosphor's 'list-checks' shows a checklist with checkmarks, the standard task list / todo icon

location.reason: Phosphor's 'map-pin' is a teardrop-shaped location marker, the universal map pin. Also has 'map-pin-line' with a base line, but 'map-pin' is the standard.

map.reason: Phosphor's 'map-trifold' shows a folded map, the standard map view icon. Preferred over 'globe' which conveys world/language.

directions.reason: Phosphor's 'signpost' shows a directional signpost, conveying route directions. Confirmed on v0.app. Candidates: 'path' (abstract line), 'navigation-arrow' (compass needle). Signpost is the clearest directions metaphor.

compass.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a compass rose icon for navigation and exploration

current-location.reason: Phosphor's 'crosshair' is a targeting crosshair, the standard 'my location' icon used in maps. Also has 'crosshair-simple' for a cleaner variant.

measure.reason: Phosphor's 'ruler' is a measurement ruler icon, directly matching the measure/distance concept

trending-up.reason: Phosphor's 'trend-up' shows an upward trending arrow, the standard growth/increase indicator. Confirmed on icon-icons.com.

trending-down.reason: Phosphor's 'trend-down' shows a downward trending arrow, the standard decline/decrease indicator

balance.reason: Phosphor's 'scales' is a balance/justice scales icon, directly matching the balance concept. Confirmed on v0.app.

swap.reason: Phosphor's 'arrows-left-right' shows bidirectional horizontal arrows, conveying transfer/exchange/swap. Candidates: 'arrows-counter-clockwise' (more circular, like refresh), 'shuffle' (random). Bidirectional arrows are the standard swap metaphor.

savings.reason: Phosphor's 'piggy-bank' is a piggy bank icon, the universal savings metaphor. Confirmed on v0.app with multiple weight variants.

vault.reason: Phosphor has a 'vault' icon representing a secure safe/vault. This is a direct name match for the safe/vault concept.

docs.reason: Phosphor's 'book' is a closed book icon, the standard documentation/reference symbol

book-open.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, an open book icon for reading or active documentation

graduation.reason: Phosphor's 'graduation-cap' is a mortarboard graduation cap, the standard education/academic icon. Confirmed on Iconbolt. Also has 'student' as an alternative.

briefcase.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, a briefcase icon for work/business. Confirmed on v0.app.

company.reason: Phosphor's 'buildings' shows multiple office buildings, suitable for company/office concepts. Also has 'building-office' but 'buildings' conveys a broader corporate presence.

organization.reason: Same as company -- Phosphor's 'buildings' is the closest match for organization/corporate/enterprise. No distinct org-chart-people icon exists in Phosphor; 'tree-structure' is used for the 'tree' semantic icon already.

news.reason: Phosphor's 'newspaper' is a folded newspaper icon for news/blog content. Also has 'newspaper-clipping' for a torn-out article variant, but 'newspaper' is the standard news icon.

rss.reason: Direct name match in Phosphor, the RSS feed broadcast symbol. Also has 'rss-simple' for a cleaner variant. Confirmed on v0.app.
